description: This file defines the 'PredefinedShelfService' class, which manages predefined bookshelves (such as 'To Read', 'Reading', 'Read', etc.) within a book tracking application. It provides methods for retrieving, creating, populating test data, and organizing books within these predefined shelves in relation to the current user. It interacts with repositories for books, shelves, authors, tags, publishers, and users.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing predefined bookshelves for users, including creation, retrieval, population with test data, and organizing books within these shelves. It leverages multiple repositories and provides utility methods for handling bookshelves.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a predefined shelf by its ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a predefined shelf.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Returns all predefined shelves associated with the currently logged-in user.

methods.name: findToReadShelf
methods.description: Gets the 'To Read' predefined shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findReadingShelf
methods.description: Gets the 'Reading' predefined shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findReadShelf
methods.description: Gets the 'Read' predefined shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findDidNotFinishShelf
methods.description: Gets the 'Did Not Finish' predefined shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndLoggedInUser
methods.description: Finds a predefined shelf by name and current user.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of predefined shelves.

methods.name: populateTestData
methods.description: Populates repositories with test data and initializes predefined shelves for all users. Runs after construction.

methods.name: populateAuthorRepository
methods.description: Populates author repository with generated test authors.

methods.name: populateTagRepository
methods.description: Populates tag repository with generated test tags.

methods.name: populatePublisherRepository
methods.description: Populates publisher repository with generated test publishers.

methods.name: populateShelfRepository
methods.description: Creates and saves predefined shelves for a given user.

methods.name: populateBookRepository
methods.description: Populates book repository with generated test books linked to authors, tags, shelves, and publishers.

methods.name: setShelfForEveryBookInBookRepository
methods.description: Assigns predefined shelves to all books in the repository.

methods.name: createPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Creates predefined shelf objects for a user based on enum values.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfByNameAsString
methods.description: Retrieves a shelf by its string name within the logged-in user context.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfByPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves a shelf by its enum-based predefined name for the current user.

methods.name: getBooksInChosenPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Returns books in a specified shelf, or all books if 'All books' is specified.

methods.name: isAllBooksShelf
methods.description: Checks if the given shelf name corresponds to the 'All books' special shelf.

methods.name: getBooksInAllPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Aggregates books from all shelves accessible to the user.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all predefined shelves from the repository.

methods.name: getBooksInPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Static method to collect books from a list of predefined shelves.

methods.name: isPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Checks if a string corresponds to a predefined shelf name.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Converts a string into a predefined shelf enum, if valid.
